fact: Seychelles Nation reports that the National Computer Emergency Response Team of Seychelles (CERT-SC) designed and delivered the third National Cyberdrill hosted by the Department of ICT, so the national team exists and operates; the date is the article's published date.

The Seychelles Department of ICT launched the newly established National Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-SC) as the country's frontline for monitoring cyber threats and coordinating national responses.
Seychelles Cabinet approved the establishment of a National Cyber Security Coordination Committee and a Cyber Secretariat to protect critical infrastructure.
CERT-SC's own RFC 2350 profile v1.0 describes it as a national CERT under the Department of Information and Communication Technology, with all Internet users in Seychelles as constituency.
